body.statement: For every finite measure \(\mu\), the closed unit ball of \(L^\infty(\mu)=(L^1(\mu))^*\) is compact in the weak-star topology.

source.verbatim_statement: The unit sphere K of the space E* adjoint to E, with the neighborhoods (1:1) for G = E, is a bicompact Hausdorff space.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the original Alaoglu (1940) source scan, Internet Archive identifier IA41548405_0097. The paper uses old terminology: its unit sphere denotes the closed unit ball; specialization to (L1(mu))* = L-infinity(mu) gives the cited weak-star compactness leaf.
